Architecture Notes
SD-WAN Platform 128 Technology (Juniper 128T) — managed via 128T Conductor
Store IP space 172.16.0.0/12 — per-store /26 allocations in retail_networks dataset (~32 subnets/store)
Data source gap 128T router configs not exportable via standard FW config pipeline. Per-store edge device inventory requires 128T Conductor API export — not currently available.
Security visibility Retail store traffic is SNAT'd through hub FWs. CrowdStrike endpoint telemetry provides store-level host visibility. Hub FW rules in fw_rule_db control what is permitted in/out of the retail fabric.
IP lookup Use iplookup.sh -l <172.x.x.x> to identify store location from retail_networks dataset.
